description: A reified 'addresses' relation: a claim that ANSWERS or speaks to a research question (subject = claim, object = question). Relations are separate assertions with their own metadata. Grounded in the MIRA community schema (github.com/MIRA-science/schema, mira.yaml: slot addresses, domain Claim, range Question); first ported (2026-05) from the DiscourseGraphs coalition's OWL (github.com/DiscourseGraphs/schemas, dg:addresses) — historical lineage, kept as attribution. RRGI's intentional divergence (matching supports): subject/object are dual-addressed via com.atproto.repo.strongRef (uri + cid) instead of a bare at-uri — an extension intended to be proposed upstream to MIRA.

subject.description: Dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the addressing node (the claim). RRGI divergence from upstream's bare at-uri: com.atproto.repo.strongRef requires both uri and cid, so the CID is mandatory.

object.description: Dual-addressed reference (URI + CID) to the addressed node (the question). See subject: RRGI divergence, CID mandatory.

description.description: Optional elaboration on how the claim addresses the question.
